description: This file defines a Cookies class within the Slim Framework's PSR7 implementation. It manages HTTP cookies for requests and responses, allowing setting, retrieving, and converting cookie data to headers, with support for default properties and parsing cookie headers.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP cookies in the Slim Framework's PSR7 implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cookies object with an optional array of request cookies.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default properties for cookies, such as 'value', 'domain', 'path', etc.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie value from the request cookies by name, with an optional default.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cookie for the response with specified properties, merging with defaults.

methods.name: toHeaders
methods.description: Converts all response cookies into an array of header strings suitable for HTTP headers.

methods.name: toHeader
methods.description: Converts a single cookie's properties into a 'Set-Cookie' header string.
